breakdown.description: Steady Bernoulli is applied to a rapid transient (water hammer); unsteady compressibility/elasticity effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that using steady Bernoulli for a rapid transient event like water hammer is incorrect. It replaced this with the appropriate Joukowsky water hammer equation (Δp = ρ × a × ΔV) and explicitly stated, 'Note that steady Bernoulli is not used because it cannot capture transient pressure surges,' which directly aligns with the correction made in the ground truth.
